sentences.text: Perused the case diary / challan papers.

2] This is the first application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.29/2024 registered at Police Station-Bagli, District-Dewas (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376(3), 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 5(L), 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
The applicant is in custody since 31.1.2024.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.

4 ] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix was a consenting party and resided with the applicant for around three days and not even alleged any physical sexual intercourse by the present applicant and her age is also disputed.
It is also submitted that the applicant is in jail since 31.1.2024 and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take a long time.
Thus, it is submitted that the bail application be allowed.
5] Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the 2 MCRC-28511-2024 prayer and it is submitted that the age of the prosecutrix was 16 years at the time of the incident.

6] On due consideration of the rival submissions, and on perusal of the case diary as also taking note of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C., this Court finds it expedient to allow the bail application.
Accordingly, without commenting upon the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

1 satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
